source: RECORDED from a live run on a dev instance of the platform (0.27.15, runner image tranibor-runner:0.27.15, opencode backend, model profile standard), 2026-11-19: a work item whose brief asked the agent to call the `task` tool once. Nothing had to be scrubbed (no host, token or name of the instance appears in the journal). The `task` call is real: titled `task` when it starts, then retitled with the call's description; its rawInput carries subagent_type; its output carries the child session's final answer. No update carries `_meta` or a parent id, and the child session's own tool calls are absent (opencode's ACP adapter drops them): the opencode rule of tranibor_core.agent_tree is now read from a recording, not only from the adapter's source.

Do not use for the user's own application code, or for any project that is not configuring opencode itself.
